summary: Verified hero line-art fix on Platinum Group home page at 1920x800. Image renders with object-contain in a 100svh bg-ink container. Full artwork is visible vertically, tower/roof tops at top edge are NOT cropped, and the central black sky gap at top-center is visible. Image's black background blends seamlessly with the page's bg-ink (no visible box/seams). Hero headline 'WE BUILD UPWARDS', subtitle, and all three hero buttons (hero-discover-button, hero-brochure-button, hero-book-visit-button) render legibly over the artwork. Nav (HOME/GREENS/GREENS OPULENCE/PROJECTS/ENQUIRE) readable at top. Parallax works — image translates and scales subtly on scroll, and hero scrolls away into next section normally.

issues: Expected black bars on left/right at 1920x800 because artwork is 16:9 in a 2.4:1 container — these blend perfectly with bg-ink so it is visually seamless (as intended).

critical_code_review_comments: Framer-motion warning in console: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' for useScroll — the section has class 'relative' so this is likely a benign initial warning but worth checking motion target ref timing.

Note: The current /brand/hero-lineart.webp (1672x941) depicts an upward interior view of two buildings with balconies/vegetation and a central sky gap — matches the described requirements (tower tips near top, central black sky gap, pure black background). If a different artwork was intended, the asset itself would need replacement (not a code issue).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero image bounding rect: 2016x840 (natural 1672x941), object-fit contain, parent bg rgb(7,7,8) = bg-ink. Section height 800px (100svh). Image spans full vertical height with no top/bottom crop. Parallax via framer-motion useScroll + useTransform on y (0-22%) and scale (1.05-1.18).
